basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software developer based out of Austin, Texas. I love gaming, especially Genshin Impact, and I spend most of my free time diving into game mechanics and optimizing character builds. I'm also a big fan of indie games like Super Auto Pets. During work hours, I'm coding away, but in the evenings and weekends, I'm active online. I'm single and enjoy discussing theories about Marvel shows and other pop culture topics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a deep passion for gaming. I taught myself game theory through countless hours of gameplay and community engagement. My job as a developer further hones my analytical skills, which I apply to game mechanics.
